notes.title: Dynaforce V3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello, I'm addressing you with the update notes for Dynaforce V3 Version. This update, released after a long hiatus, actually took longer than anticipated. However, it will present itself as the most extensive and significant update Dynaforce has received so far.[/b][/h1]

[b][h1]New Additions:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[] Minimap has been reintroduced into the game.
[] With adjustments made to the characters, now you'll be able to play as a military character.
[] 3 new maps have been added.
[] Usable tanks and helicopters have been included in the game.
[*] Spawn point selection feature on the map has been added.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[] The error occurring on the startup screen has been resolved.
[] Issue with non-functioning sound settings has been fixed.
[] The problem of character color not changing has been resolved.
[] Spawn issue outside the map has been addressed.
[*] Weapons with effects issues have been corrected.
[/list]

[h1][b]Some of the features we're continuing to work on include:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[]
[] Ranking system
[] Weapon patterns
[] New movement system
[/list]

[i][b]Our aim is to transform Dynaforce into a more competitive environment. Through our upcoming updates, we aim to create a competitive and enjoyable atmosphere. We'll be opening our Discord server after the update is released and we're eagerly looking forward to inviting you.[/b][/i]

[u]For sponsorship and communication: exteerstudio@gmail.com[/u]

notes.title: Dynaforce V2.1 Update Realesed
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, I'd like to share the Dynaforce 2.01 update notes with you. Some of the features and changes that were added to the game had a significant negative impact, so they have been removed.[/h2]

[b]Update Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Characters have been dressed in blue and red to distinguish between friendly and enemy characters.
[*] 3 new weapons have been added.
[*] The spray of the weapons has been fixed.
[*] Weapon damage has been increased; sniper rifles now fire single shots.
[*] 2 new maps have been added to the game.
[*] A smaller map has been introduced for the Free for All game mode
[/list]

[u]For sponsorship and communication, please reach out to us at exteerstudio@gmail.com.[/u]

notes.title: Dynaforce V2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Dynaforce V2.0 is now live. With this update, we have transitioned to the core concept of Dynaforce, which is the "low-poly" concept. We've made significant changes in Dynaforce.[/h3]

[b]Removed Game Modes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Kill Confirmed
[*] Rush
[*] Search and Destroy
[*] Game modes that are not part of our future update plans have been removed from Dynaforce because they deviated from the core concept.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]In this update, we have also addressed several issues and made various improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] We resolved the issue of small appearances of enemy and friendly characters and added new characters.
[*] Fixed the aiming issue.
[*] Improved animations.
[*] Conducted comprehensive optimization.
[*] Reduced the number of maps to 2 and added new maps.
[*] Additionally, we have made enhancements in VFX (Visual Effects) and SFX (Sound Effects).
[*] Implemented various fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Other Features We Plan to Introduce with Future Updates:
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h1]Tank and Helicopter System
[*] Artillery and Deployable Weapons[/h1]
[/list]

For sponsorship and communication, please contact us at exteerstudio@gmail.com.

notes.title: Update V1.01
notes.notes:
"Hello, the update v1.01 is now live, and the changes we have made are as follows:

[olist]
[*] The DeadCity map has been removed from the game.
[*] Two new maps have been introduced.
[*] The Crosshair has been improved for better usability.
[*] Changes have been made to the usability of weapons.
[*] General bug fixes have been implemented.
[/olist]
We would also like to mention some of the features we are planning to add in future versions:

[olist]
[*] V1.02: Changes to the main menu and HUD designs.
[*] V1.02: We are considering reintroducing the Minimap to the game as we currently see it as a significant missing feature.
[*] V1.02: Visual effects (VFX) improvements.
[*] V1.03: Achievements.
[*] V1.03: Enhancements to all animations.
[/olist]
[b]These mentioned updates will be significant, while we will continue to provide regular weekly updates. We appreciate your support and encourage you to reach out for communication and sponsorship opportunities at exteerstudio@gmail.com.[/b]
